title: J-Series 350 SOHC Cylinder Head & Valvetrain
title_gu: J-સિરીઝ ૩૫૦ સિલિન્ડર હેડ અને વાલ્વટ્રેન સ્કીમેટિક

components.name: SOHC Camshaft Assembly with Decompressor
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Align timing mark punch dot flush with cylinder head gasket face before torquing sprocket.

components.name: Hydraulic Roller Rocker Arm (Intake)
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Pre-prime hydraulic lifter cartridge in clean engine oil before assembly.

components.name: Hydraulic Roller Rocker Arm (Exhaust)
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Check end-float clearance with micrometer feeler (<0.18 mm).

components.name: Cylinder Head Main Studs & Washers (4 Pcs Set)
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Always torque in diagonal criss-cross pattern; apply engine oil to threads and under washer face.

components.name: Genuine MLS 3-Layer Metal Cylinder Head Gasket
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Single-use MLS gasket; never use liquid gasket maker on metal gasket face.

components.name: Automatic Hydraulic Cam Chain Tensioner
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Retract ratchet plunger with screwdriver clip before bolting to cylinder block.

components.name: Outer Clutch Basket with Primary Driven Gear
components.name_gu: આઉટર ક્લચ બાસ્કેટ અને પ્રાઇમરી ગિયર
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Inspect basket fingers for notch grooves caused by hard launches; deburr with needle file if minor.

components.name: Slipper & Assist Inner Clutch Hub (Cam Ramp)
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: CAUTION: Hub nut is reverse-threaded (left-hand thread). Lock basket with special holding tool before torquing to 100 Nm.

components.name: Kevlar Friction Clutch Plates Pack (Set of 7)
components.name_gu: કેવલર ફ્રિક્શન ક્લચ પ્લેટ્સ (૭ નંગ સેટ)
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Must soak friction plates in fresh 15W-50 oil for minimum 30 minutes before installing.

components.name: Steel Clutch Separator Plates (Set of 6)
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Lay plates on flat glass sheet with feeler gauge to check warpage (<0.10 mm tolerance).

components.name: Assist Clutch Springs & Bolts Set (3 Pcs)
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Tighten spring bolts 1 turn each sequentially to avoid cocking the pressure plate.

key_specifications.flywheel_weight: 11.2 kg (Heavy Cast-Iron Inertia for Iconic Thump)
key_specifications.connecting_rod_bearing: Phosphor Bronze Small End Bush & Roller Big End
key_specifications.runout_tolerance: <0.03 mm on V-Blocks with Dial Indicator

components.name: Heavy Cast-Iron Flywheels Pair (11.2 kg Matched Set)
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: True the twin flywheels between dead centers on lathe; radial and axial runout must not exceed 0.025 mm.

components.name: Forged Connecting Rod with Phosphor Bronze Bush
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Ream the small-end bronze bush with hand adjustable reamer for exact 16.00 mm gudgeon pin fit.

components.name: Hardened Precision Ground Crankpin & Taper Lock Nuts
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Clean taper bore with surgical spirit before press fit; torque nuts to 140 Nm and peen lock washers.

components.name: Timing Drive Half-Time Pinion & Nut
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Use pinion puller tool only; never hit pinion with hammer which knocks crankshaft out of true.

title: Sherpa 450 Liquid-Cooled Water Pump & Thermostat Loop
title_gu: શેરપા ૪૫૦ લિક્વિડ-કૂલ્ડ વોટર પમ્પ & થર્મોસ્ટેટ લૂપ

key_specifications.cooling_type: Pressurized Liquid Cooling with Integrated Water Pump

components.name: High-Flow Water Pump Impeller & Shaft
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Inspect impeller PPS blades for cavitation wear; ensure smooth spin with zero shaft play.

components.name: Ceramic Mechanical Water Seal & Oil Seal Set
components.name_gu: સિરામિક મિકેનિકલ વોટર સીલ & ઓઇલ સીલ
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: CAUTION: Never touch the white ceramic seal face with bare fingers; oil contamination causes weep hole leak.

components.name: 82°C Wax Pellet Thermostat Unit & Housing
components.master_tech_advice: Master Tech Ramesh: Test thermostat in boiling water with thermometer; valve must lift >7 mm at 95°C.
